quarterly_data.signal: Wolfspeed received a conditional loan commitment letter from the U.S. Department of War (Office of Strategic Capital) to support domestic development and production of silicon carbide materials and wide bandgap power devices. The commitment, which remains subject to diligence, definitive agreements, government approvals and offtake agreements, would require Wolfspeed to undertake a multi-year program: the buildout of domestic SiC wafer and power device production; establishing, expanding and/or onshoring domestic low-voltage and/or high-voltage gallium nitride (GaN) power device production; advancing GaN-on-SiC radio-frequency epitaxial wafer technology; and developing domestic radiation-hardening capabilities for its current SiC and future GaN products. Wolfspeed cites its domestic manufacturing footprint in North Carolina, New York and Arkansas. CEO Robert Feurle: 'SiC and GaN have critical national security applications... With this financing, the company would be well positioned to not only continue to serve the DoW but also expand its capabilities.'
